evals.prompt: Implement EnqueueAsync in fixtures/BoundedQueue.cs so it honors the documented contract, and add xunit tests in the same project. Report every dotnet command you actually ran.
evals.expected_output: Implements a bounded channel enqueue with Wait backpressure, threads the caller's CancellationToken through the write, throws OperationCanceledException promptly on cancel, refuses enqueue after Complete, adds xunit tests for full/empty/cancel/complete cases, and reports exact dotnet test output instead of claiming an unrun check.

evals.prompt: Add an UpsertCustomerAsync method to CustomerRepository that uses the injected DbContext, saves with SaveChangesAsync, propagates the CancellationToken, and disposes whatever the method itself creates.
evals.expected_output: Implements the method, threads the token into SaveChangesAsync, scopes any owned IDisposable/IAsyncDisposable with using/await using, does not dispose the injected DbContext it does not own, and adds a test.

evals.prompt: Add a helper to our net48 class library that parses an ISO date into a DateOnly and formats it back. The project targets net48 only.
evals.expected_output: Detects that DateOnly does not exist on net48 (added in .NET 6) and either reports the version mismatch and asks, or proposes a net48-compatible alternative such as DateTime/DateTimeOffset, rather than emitting code that cannot compile.

evals.prompt: Review src/PaymentService.cs read-only and list only confirmed bugs. Do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: This is a read-only review request, so it routes to the review skill rather than the implementation skill.

evals.prompt: Fix the NullReferenceException in OrderParser.Parse and while you are at it, check whether the .csproj Nullable setting is right for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Implements the NullReferenceException fix as the primary authorized change, and treats the Nullable project check as a secondary project concern it flags rather than silently editing project files.

evals.prompt: Change PriceCalculator.Round to use MidpointRounding.ToEven and keep everything else as is.
evals.expected_output: Applies only the requested rounding change, preserves the public signature and surrounding behavior, and does not modernize or refactor unrelated code.
